name: bump-plugin-version
tagline_zh: 改完技能或插件，提交前总忘升版本？这个 Skill 自动帮你 bump，连 hal-9000 的仓库路径都门儿清。
tagline_en: Tired of forgetting to bump versions before commit? This skill auto-bumps for skills/ and plugins/, knows your.
desc_en: (project) Use when editing any file under skills/hal-skills/ or plugins/hal-voice/ to bump the plugin version before committing
why_zh: 同类工具要你手写路径或正则，它直接认准 hal-9000 的目录结构，改完即升，零配置。
why_en: Unlike generic bumpers, it's hardwired to hal-9000's layout—no config, just works where you edit.
